content:
jenna: Quick sync — I opened a docs PR for the new billing export preview and tiered spend alerts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12456. Wanted to check the panels and the SDK example before merge.

marta: looking now. main things: the alert text needs to mention 'preview' state, and the dashboard panel should use panel_id=8123 (not 8122). small copy nits. :memo:

lia: for the SDK snippet, should we show a full example for header attribution per-route? customers keep asking how to send team_id in metering headers. idea: short Python + JS snippets.

sam: @jenna — grafana query for the new panel (per-route spend in USD) is fine but tweak to use `sum by (route) (rate(billing_cost_usd_total[5m])) * 60`. also add `or on(route) group_left(team) route_team_mapping` for route->team joins. will paste exact query in a sec.

jenna: paste it here when you can — I'll update the dashboard JSON. also does the PR include the migration note for Dedicated customers who rely on old metric name?

sam: query: ```
sum by (route) (rate(billing_cost_usd_total{env="prod"}[5m])) * 60
```
and if you need team attribution (assuming we expose route_team_mapping): ```
sum by (team) (sum by (route,team) (rate(billing_cost_usd_total{env="prod"}[5m])) * 60)
```
This avoids double-counting when multiple routes map to the same team.

marta: nice. add a short note under "Dashboard panels" that customers may need to remap their old route labels to teams — mention the migration script link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tools/tree/main/migration/route-to-team.

lia: SDK snippet (Python) — short example for per-request headers: ```python
import requests
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer $API_KEY", "X-Redwood-Team": "team_123", "X-Redwood-Route": "/v1/generate"}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", headers=headers, json={"prompt":"..."})
print(resp.json())
```
JS snippet for reference: ```js
fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + API_KEY, 'X-Redwood-Team': 'team_123' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: '...' })
})
```
Add a callout that headers are honored for billing attribution in preview but may change in GA.

jenna: thanks — I'll add both snippets and the callout. also the docs-ci is failing one lint rule on the alert copy (max 120 chars).

docs-ci: test failure — docs/labs/billing-preview.md: line 42 exceeds 120 chars (found 134). See CI output: https://ci.redwood-inference.ci/1234

marta: can we shorten the example alert message to: "Preview alert: projected spend for Team X exceeds tier threshold" — that should pass length and keep meaning.

jenna: updated the PR with that copy and pushed a fix for panel_id and the Python snippet. PTAL.

sam: LGTM from query side. I left one nit about a code fence language tag in the JS snippet.

lia: I'll file a tiny follow-up to move the SDK snippet into a shared snippets directory after merge.

jenna: awesome — merging after CI green. thank you all :rocket:
